locations.name: Village Square
locations.description: Dusk. Tables are still set. No one is here.

locations.name: Keeper's House
locations.description: Swept floors. A chair stands empty at the head of the table.

locations.name: Fields
locations.description: Straw figures lean over a harvest no one came for.

locations.name: Riverbank
locations.description: The river moves. Nothing else does.

locations.name: Schoolhouse
locations.description: Books lie open on every desk.

locations.name: Village Gate
locations.description: The road ends here. The gate is shut.
